popular.description: 获取首页推荐写真套图

actions.code: (() => { const normalizeId = (href) => { try { return new URL(href, '{{baseUrl}}').pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } catch (e) { return String(href || '').replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?635k\.com/i, '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } }; const pickImage = (img) => { if (!img) return ''; const value = img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-original') || img.getAttribute('src') || ''; return value ? new URL(value, '{{baseUrl}}').href : ''; }; const results = []; document.querySelectorAll('ul.topsige li a[href]').forEach((link) => { const href = link.getAttribute('href') || ''; const title = (link.getAttribute('title') || link.querySelector('h3')?.textContent || link.textContent || '').trim(); const id = normalizeId(href); if (id && title && id.indexOf('post/') === 0) { results.push({ id, title, cover: pickImage(link.querySelector('img')), url: new URL(href, '{{baseUrl}}').href, genre: '推荐' }); } }); return JSON.stringify(results); })();

(() => { let raw = String('{{mangaId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) { try { raw = new URL(raw).pathname; } catch (e) {} } raw = raw.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); return '{{baseUrl}}/' + raw; })();

(() => { const pickImage = (img) => { if (!img) return ''; const value = img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-original') || img.getAttribute('src') || ''; return value ? new URL(value, '{{baseUrl}}').href : ''; }; const title = (document.querySelector('.focusbox-title')?.textContent || document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent || document.title || '').replace(/\s*-\s*丝袜美腿\s*$/i, '').trim(); const category = (document.querySelector('.list-meta a.item-meta')?.textContent || '').trim(); const date = (document.querySelector('.list-meta time')?.textContent || '').trim(); const readText = (document.querySelector('.list-meta span')?.textContent || '').trim(); const tags = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article#lightgallery .tags a')).map((el) => (el.textContent || '').trim()).filter(Boolean); const cover = pickImage(document.querySelector('article#lightgallery img.img')) || document.querySelector('meta[property="og:image"]')?.getAttribute('content') || ''; const description = [category, date, readText].filter(Boolean).join(' / '); return JSON.stringify({ title, cover, author: '', status: 'completed', description, genre: tags.length > 0 ? tags.join(', ') : category }); })();

actions.code: (() => { let raw = String('{{mangaId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) { try { raw = new URL(raw).pathname; } catch (e) {} } raw = raw.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); return '{{baseUrl}}/' + raw; })();

(() => { let id = ''; try { id = new URL(window.location.href, '{{baseUrl}}').pathname.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } catch (e) { id = String('{{mangaId}}' || '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } const date = (document.querySelector('.list-meta time')?.textContent || '').trim(); return JSON.stringify([{ id, title: 'Gallery', url: '{{baseUrl}}/' + id + '?page=all', publishTime: date, date }]); })();

getPageList.description: 获取套图完整图片列表

actions.code: (() => { let raw = String('{{chapterId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) { try { raw = new URL(raw).pathname; } catch (e) {} } raw = raw.replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); return '{{baseUrl}}/' + raw + '?page=all'; })();

(() => { const pages = []; const seen = []; document.querySelectorAll('article#lightgallery img.img').forEach((img) => { const value = img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-original') || img.getAttribute('src') || ''; if (!value || value.startsWith('data:image')) return; const imageUrl = new URL(value, '{{baseUrl}}').href; if (seen.indexOf(imageUrl) >= 0) return; seen.push(imageUrl); pages.push({ index: pages.length, url: imageUrl, imageUrl }); }); return JSON.stringify(pages); })();
